hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; corepack enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ pnpm-lock.yaml -nt node_modules/.modules.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'SessionStart: pnpm install failed' >&2; exit 1; }; fi; if [ ! -f apps/ava-cli/dist/main.cjs ]; then pnpm build:ava-cli >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'SessionStart: build:ava-cli failed' >&2; exit 1; }; fi

if ! command -v ngrok >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew install ngrok >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install --cask ngrok >/dev/null 2>&1; else echo 'ngrok not installed and brew not available' >&2; fi; fi
